fields.description: Turn off to stop recording changes. The feed keeps serving what is already recorded.
fields.label: Record Changes

fields.description: Delete change log rows older than this, once Arc-One has acknowledged reading them. Unacknowledged rows are kept until the hard limit below.
fields.label: Change Log Retention (days)

fields.description: Delete rows older than this even if Arc-One never acknowledged them, so a consumer that is gone for good cannot grow the log forever. Arc-One detects rows lost this way and re-syncs.
fields.label: Hard Retention Limit (days)

fields.description: The feed withholds rows younger than this, so a row whose transaction commits a moment after a higher-numbered one is never skipped. 0 disables the delay.
fields.label: Settle Window (seconds)

fields.description: The lowest cursor Arc-One still needs, reported by synced-worker. Rows at or below it may be pruned.
fields.label: Acknowledged Cursor

fields.description: The highest cursor ever pruned. A consumer whose cursor is below it missed rows and must re-sync.
fields.label: Pruned Through

fields.description: Only these DocTypes are recorded. Adding one does not backfill - run a full sync from Arc-One after adding.
fields.label: Tracked DocTypes
